harnessRepo.title: Guardrails
harnessRepo.sub: How strictly agnts-guard checks {agent}'s work in this repository, while it works and after.
harnessRepo.agentSub: agnts scans CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/ and .mcp.json for text that tries to steer an agent. It never runs this repository's hooks or MCP servers.
harnessRepo.agentNotScanned: Not scanned yet: the next run in this repository scans the files.
harnessRepo.agentWarn: {n, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} may try to steer an agent. Runs treat these files as data, never as instructions; read them before you trust them.
harnessRepo.profileHelp: How strict the in-run checks are for this repository.
harnessRepo.profileHelp_minimal: Only secrets and enforced rules are blocked; build checked before {agent} finishes.
harnessRepo.profileHelp_standard: Also blocks skipped tests, silenced linters and edits to check configuration; build and lint must pass before {agent} finishes.
harnessRepo.profileHelp_strict: Also blocks swallowed errors and removed assertions, runs the tests before {agent} finishes, and may ask for facts before editing a file.
harnessRepo.secretAllowHelp: Path globs where fake keys are expected, besides testdata/, fixtures/ and *.example.
harnessRepo.checksSub: Quick formatters and linters agnts-guard runs on each file {agent} edits, so problems are fixed while the change is fresh.
harnessRepo.checksOffHelp: {agent} is not checked after each edit; the checks after the run still apply.
harnessRepo.ownChecksHelp: Replace the checks agnts derives from the toolchains with your list.
harnessRepo.derivedNone: agnts knows no per-file checks for this repository's toolchains.
harnessRepo.checkCmdHelp: '{file}' is the edited file and '{dir}' its directory, both relative to the repository.
harnessRepo.coverageSub: After the checks pass, agnts runs the tests once more with coverage and shows which added lines no test ran.
harnessRepo.coverageHelp: An extra test run after the checks; it never fails the run.
harnessRepo.thresholdHelp: Below it, the code review gets a coverage finding. 0 turns the finding off.
harnessRepo.coverageCmdHelp: Leave empty to use the command agnts derives.
harnessRepo.coverageReportHelp: A Go cover profile or lcov file, in the repository or under /agnts/out/.
harnessRepo.coverageNoDerived: agnts knows no coverage command for these toolchains: set one.
harnessRepo.acceptanceHelp: After the preview, agnts checks the ticket's acceptance criteria in the running app and shows the results with screenshots.
harnessRepo.acceptanceNoPreview: Needs a preview command: set one when you edit the repository.
harnessRepo.starterSub: Specific, checkable conventions for this repository's languages. They are added as suggestions: nothing applies until you adopt them.
harnessRepo.starterNone: No starter pack fits this repository's toolchains.
harnessRepo.starterOffer: Suggest {n, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}
harnessRepo.starterAdded: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing new to suggest} one {# rule suggested} other {# rules suggested}}
harnessRepo.layersBlockHelp: With an approved architecture, agnts flags a change that adds an import its layers do not allow. On, the flag is a blocker that agnts's own review sends back to the coder before you see the change.
